assessment.diversity_evidence: Nearly all stories share the same premise of Nia hoping to make music with hesitant Mateo. Most (including s000014 and s000053) resolve this with Nia performing a solo; s000058 and s000021 instead have Mateo write a rhythm for her to play, while s000017 and s000041 resolve the hesitation with a private duet. These are meaningful but limited branches, and the language and endings remain very similar across the sample.
